unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: Except for the aborted installed-startup receipt and the already-existing isolated compiler receipt, per-entry private-byte/commit baselines, peaks, and post-completion return are not measured.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: After compilation and service launch are explicitly re-authorized, run the complete visible Electron workflow and per-definition cold/steady/peak/idle-TTL measurements. Preserve nulls until then.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: The installed-app baseline reached startup only and was aborted when Quartz/esbuild compiled unexpectedly. It does not cover dashboard navigation, Garden, Learn, ingestion, artifacts, browsers, cancellation, restart, or idle reclamation.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Capture a no-compiler lean installed baseline before any Runtime V2 parity claim.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: job:runtime-setup, job:artifact-render, job:speech-media-tools, and job:runtime-probes are honest aggregate families. Each source-selected executable/renderer/probe must become its own trusted manifest definition before cutover.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Freeze resolved executable roots, resource classes, timeouts, inputs, outputs, and rollback behavior for every leaf; reject dynamic/untrusted paths.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: Python, Node, Codex, OpenCode, Ruflo, browser, media, Docker, and office roots can spawn implementation-defined descendants. Source inspection cannot prove the complete installed descendant set or memory attribution.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Capture live process trees per entry and enforce Job Object containment before first instruction; record every breakaway incompatibility.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: ComfyUI setup/server, Spotify playback browser, and Recall use detached/unref launches. Any surviving detached child violates Runtime V2 sole ownership until converted.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Remove detach/unref from every Breadboard-launched process and launch it suspended/contained through Runtime V2. Independently managed processes must use separate external entries with no ownership claim.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: mem0 is enabled by default when embeddings are configured and caches its engine/better-sqlite3 handles on globalThis. It has no disposal or idle boundary, so its retained dashboard memory is unknown.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Measure first-use/steady/large-index memory, then move the engine to the registered Runtime V2 on-demand leased service with an idle TTL; do not solve this only with a dashboard heap cap.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: User-installed stdio MCP connections can name commands that are not part of a versioned trusted runtime manifest.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Allow-list every app-launched local stdio definition under service:local-mcp-stdio; keep only remote or independently managed endpoints under external:remote-mcp-endpoints. Runtime V2 must never accept an arbitrary executable path from a renderer or request.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: Most of the 37 legacy agent managers keep active runs/events in process-local or globalThis Maps. Transcript cards survive, but a server restart loses execution; retry starts a new attempt. Agent TARS and Deep Research are partial exceptions, not a generic solution.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Move attempt state/event replay/fencing to Runtime V2 and classify interrupted or uncertain work without blind retry.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: Video Use falsely declares Garden support, Garden hides Meeting Notes selection, Terminal omits active Meeting Notes from conflict detection, and several command-hub empty-state predicates omit real agents.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Freeze and fix the pre-migration behavior contract before using it as the Runtime V2 parity gate.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: Postiz and Inbox Zero use Docker/Podman and may wake WSL2. Per-container limits exist for Postiz, but actual host commit, WSL retention, Inbox Zero container limits, and post-idle return are unmeasured.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Measure engine/WSL/container trees before, peak, after work, and after idle shutdown; keep external-engine ownership distinct from project-stack ownership.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: OfficeCLI may reuse a resident process serving an open file. That resident is not currently represented by an independently measured lifecycle definition.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Determine installed resident process identity, ownership, exit protocol, idle policy, and memory before manifest freeze.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: This inventory reflects the active, dirty worktree on 2026-08-25. Parallel registries and uncommitted source can drift after the audit.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Generate and hash a frozen inventory snapshot from the committed pre-migration registries and fail CI on drift.

unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.description: All 37 primary runtime-agent capability IDs join the finalized 475-row feature-parity registry, but 50 of 112 unique inventory capability references describe execution-only workflows, services, recovery paths, or tool families that are not rows in that registry.
unclassified_or_blocked_gaps.required_resolution: Before manifest freeze, either add each execution-relevant capability to the canonical parity registry or explicitly version it as an execution-inventory-only taxonomy term; CI must reject silent spelling drift.
